apps.name: Opaline
apps.subtitle: YouTube client for iOS 12+
apps.localizedDescription:
**New**

- Hold anywhere on the video to seek ([#116](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/116)). Press and hold on the picture, then drag sideways. The seek bar follows your finger and the video jumps where you let go, so you no longer have to hit the thin bar at the bottom. The taps you already know still work: the sides seek, the middle pauses.
- Search inside a channel ([#117](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/117)). Channel pages have a magnifier now, and whatever you type there searches that channel only. YouTube serves no filters for this kind of search, so there are none in the app either.
- Get a downloaded video out of the app ([#115](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/115)). The menu on a downloaded video has a new "Save to Files" row that hands the file to the usual iOS share sheet, so it can go to Files, Photos, AirDrop or another app. It is named after the video, and only the video leaves: subtitles, comments and the saved page stay where they were.
- Clear the whole search history at once ([#121](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/121)). The last row under Recent searches wipes the list, and it asks first.

**Fixes**

- The mini player no longer sits on top of the tab bar ([#118](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/118)). Tapping a tab behind the collapsed player switches to that tab instead of reopening the video.
- Stereo no longer gets spatialized on AirPods ([#119](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/119)). Ordinary two-channel sound was being turned into a fake surround field that moved when you turned your head. Video that really is multichannel still spatializes.
- The "..." menu stops closing on its own ([#128](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/128)). It was reacting to the device being tilted or put down, which made it look random when you held the phone in your hand.

**Also**

- If your device is older than Opaline supports, the README now points at [a downport for iOS 9](https://github.com/Joeviocoe/Opaline) by another developer, which runs on the iPad 2, iPad 3, iPad mini and iPhone 4S ([#125](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/125)).

apps.name: Silverphase
apps.subtitle: Native film and print simulation for iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription:
> **当前两端下载：** [macOS 1.0.1](https://github.com/akinal5765-byte/Silverphase/releases/tag/v1.0.1) · [iOS 1.1.1](https://github.com/akinal5765-byte/Silverphase/releases/tag/v1.1.1)

新增 **CineStill 800T**，已接入 iOS 与 macOS 的共享胶片目录。

- 采用上游的无防光晕背层回反射模型，提供红色光晕和 **0–8 EV 高光余量**控制。
- 新增按通用提示词生成的包装风格封面；两端卡片短名称统一为 **800T**，列表保留完整名称 **CineStill 800T**。
- 复用 Vision3 500T 的原始乳剂数据与印相校准，保留 Hanze Qiu、Andrea Volpato 的来源记录及 GPL / CC BY-SA 声明。

两端独立编号：**macOS 1.0.1（2）**、**iOS 1.1.1（3）**。

[PR #2](https://github.com/akinal5765-byte/Silverphase/pull/2) 已合并。安装包来自提交 `0e0d354c6d4813ec7cdbf6a004a3c3c3fde9525a`，其源码树与合并后的 `main` 一致。包内附构建来源与开源声明，公开包不包含个人照片、私有材料或签名凭据。

## 下载与安装

下载 **`Silverphase-1.1.1-iOS-unsigned.ipa`**，适用于 **arm64、iOS / iPadOS 18 及以上**。

这是**未签名 IPA**，需要自行完成设备签名和描述文件配置；请保留 `Silverphase-iOS-RequiredEntitlements.plist` 中的 Increased Memory Limit 能力。包内不提供证书、私钥或设备描述文件。安装方法见附件 `INSTALL.md`；校验值见 `SHA256SUMS.txt`，构建与来源信息见 `ios-build.json`。

## 验证范围

800T 的模拟器专项检查通过，公共 Release 构建与打包通过。完整移动端冒烟检查在后续读取原图细节时因内存不足中止，因此仍属部分覆盖。

签名开发版本已单独覆盖安装到 Duo，保留照片库和编辑记录；安装后未启动应用或操作验证。此版本不新增真机触控、相册权限、内存能力或全分辨率导出的验收结论。

[详细验证记录](https://github.com/akinal5765-byte/Silverphase/blob/0e0d354c6d4813ec7cdbf6a004a3c3c3fde9525a/performance/VALIDATION-CINESTILL-2026-11-02.md)。

apps.name: Tsumiru
apps.subtitle: Native manga & manhwa reader for Suwayomi-Server
apps.localizedDescription:
A manga and webtoon reader for your [Suwayomi](https://suwayomi.org/) server.

### ✨ New Features

- Added **Per-category settings for sort and filters** to the Library, including changes made offline (@aaronbamblett)
- Added notifications when a new Tsumiru or server version is out, with **Remind later** and **Ignore** (@aaronbamblett)
- Added **Offset double spreads** to the paged reader for spreads that start on an odd page (@PainTownblue)

### ⚙️ Changes

- Made long strip taps and keys scroll by **Scroll distance** instead of a whole page (@aaronbamblett)
- Changed **Keep screen on** to off by default (@aaronbamblett)
- Added Up and Down page turns in horizontal paged mode and N and P to change chapter (@aaronbamblett)

### 🚀 Improvements

- Hid empty category tabs while searching or filtering the library, with **Show empty categories during search/filtering** to keep them (@aaronbamblett)
- Moved **Create registration code** to **Manage users** and added an **Edit** button to user rows (@aaronbamblett)

### 🧩 Fixes

- Fixed the offline library not opening when Tsumiru starts without a connection (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed **Something went wrong** showing on every page while reading offline (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed library covers going blank in Safari after scrolling them off screen and back (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed the paged reader restoring an old zoom when you return to a page (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed saved searches from older WebUI versions not loading (@aaronbamblett)

*Thanks to our Weblate translators: Damien O'Neil for French, Kisnov for Catalan, Andrei Stepanov for Russian and PainTownblue for Chinese.*

## Install

You'll need a running Suwayomi server. See [Getting started](https://tsumiru.app/docs/guides/getting-started).

### Mobile

**Android:** download the universal APK below and open it to install. Smaller APKs for specific chip types are also attached.

**iOS:** the `…-ios.ipa` below is unsigned and has to be sideloaded. Add `https://tsumiru.app/apps.json` as a source in [SideStore](https://sidestore.io/) or [AltStore](https://altstore.io/) to install it and get later releases as updates.

<details>
<summary>Which sideloading tool should I use?</summary>

- **[SideStore](https://sidestore.io/)** signs and refreshes the app on the device itself, with no computer needed after setup. Best for most people.
- **[AltStore](https://altstore.io/)** expires every 7 days and only refreshes while a computer running AltServer is switched on and on the same Wi-Fi as your phone.
- **[TrollStore](https://ios.cfw.guide/installing-trollstore/)** installs permanently with no expiry, but only works on older iPhones and iOS versions with the required vulnerability.

With SideStore or AltStore the app is re-signed periodically, which those tools automate. There is no App Store build.
</details>

### Desktop

**Windows:** download `…-windows-x64.zip`, extract it anywhere, and run `tsumiru.exe`.

**macOS:** download `…-macos-universal.zip`, extract it, and move the app to Applications. If macOS blocks the first launch, approve it under System Settings → Privacy & Security.

**Linux:** the Flatpak is recommended and auto-updates.

```sh
flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists tsumiru https://flatpak.tsumiru.app/index.flatpakrepo
flatpak install tsumiru app.tsumiru.Tsumiru
```

Existing Flatpak installs keep receiving updates under `io.github.aaronbamblett.tsumiru`; no data, settings or logins move. AppImage/deb also keep that ID.

For a portable option, download `…-linux-x86_64.AppImage`, mark it executable with `chmod +x`, and run it.

### Web

Download `…-web.zip` and serve its contents with any static web server.

[Full documentation](https://tsumiru.app/)

```sh
flatpak install tsumiru app.tsumiru.Tsumiru
```

Existing Flatpak installs keep receiving updates under `io.github.aaronbamblett.tsumiru`; no data, settings or logins move. AppImage/deb also keep that ID.

For a portable option, download `…-linux-x86_64.AppImage`, mark it executable with `chmod +x`, and run it.

### Web

Download `…-web.zip` and serve its contents with any static web server.

[Full documentation](https://tsumiru.app/)
